summary: Jackson County, AL 120-foot International Derrick tower dated 1955, administered by the Alabama Forestry Commission and identical to Fabius Lookout; NHLR-registered 2009. Condition and access not stated.

notes_for_editor: Two register pages only. The Wininger page names the administrator but not the builder, so the story does not say the commission built it; the Fabius page is cited only for the shared design. Brief's 'standing' is not stated on the register, so it is proposed as unknown. Searches found no staffing, fire, fate or access source, and no later condition report.
